sound_fixed_p_exclusion_rule.statement: If F_{Q,2,alpha}^{branch}(p) is empty for a fixed retained p, then there is no R29-CAMP2 receiver point above that p.
sound_fixed_p_exclusion_rule.reason: Any receiver point induces an exhaustive AW/AE outer row; every induced row must pass the already-audited Q and Q2 branch-only rows and the two exact BY source-alpha pullback rows.
